word.name: JSON Schema for the concept of brainstorm community signals
word.title: JSON Schema for the Concept of Brainstorm Community Signals
word.description: The JSON Schema for the concept of brainstorm community signals.

jsonSchema.name: brainstormCommunitySignal
jsonSchema.title: Brainstorm Community Signal
jsonSchema.description: JSON Schema for a Brainstorm Community signal item (endorsement or veto). Items live on the single global Endorsements DList specified in COMMUNITY_ENDORSEMENTS_DLIST.md.

brainstormCommunitySignal.name: brainstormCommunitySignal
brainstormCommunitySignal.title: Brainstorm Community Signal
brainstormCommunitySignal.description: An endorsement or veto for a target pubkey within a community.

targetPubkey.name: targetPubkey
targetPubkey.title: Target Pubkey
targetPubkey.description: Pubkey of the person being endorsed or vetoed (mirrored as the event's `p` tag).

communityATag.name: communityATag
communityATag.title: Community A-Tag
communityATag.description: Addressable a-tag of the community this signal refers to. Either a kind 34550 NIP-72 community (`34550:<creator>:<d-tag>`) or a kind 39999 native Brainstorm community-record (`39999:<curator>:<d-tag>`). Mirrored as the event's `a` tag.

type.name: type
type.title: Type
type.description: Signal polarity. Conventional values: 'endorse' or 'veto'. Defaults to 'endorse' when absent. Mirrored as the event's `type` tag.

role.name: role
role.title: Role
role.description: The role being endorsed or vetoed. Conventional values: 'member' or 'moderator'; other values permitted by convention. Defaults to 'member' when absent. Mirrored as the event's `role` tag.

comments.name: comments
comments.title: Comments
comments.description: Optional free-text justification for this signal.
